metadata.purpose: Compare two Observable value sequences in arrival-independent FIFO order with strict default equality.

conditions: Exactly one boolean next followed by complete when unequal pair or unequal length is proven, or both complete equally.
Both completed and both unmatched FIFO buffers empty implies true, including two empty sources.
A nonterminating source can prevent any output. Errors forward without a boolean.

scope.parameters: Two nonreentrant Observable sources and default strict === comparator, unmatched FIFO length up to 32.
scope.callbacks: Default comparator === computed purely. Custom user comparators and their throws require a separate callback-invocation model.
scope.time: No new time source: arrival order determines FIFO alignment, equal-time notifications use caller order.
scope.reentrancy: Source-first atomic setup and post-subscription external notifications only.
exclusions: Custom comparator callbacks, errors thrown by comparators, and arbitrary ObservableInput conversion.
Buffer overflow beyond the declared maximum, synchronous subscription-time source notifications and reentrant observers.
Infinite traces do not establish liveness; nonterminating or silent sources may leave comparison unresolved.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe to source, then compareTo, with independent FIFO buffers.

ownership.sharing: None; every downstream subscription performs its own independent comparison.
ownership.reset: New comparison begins with empty queues and false completion flags.

dispatch.actionSemantics: On every next, compare against oldest opposite buffered value or enqueue locally; notification and teardown are ordered.
cancellationCheckpoints: After each pair comparison and on either source terminal event.

controls.description: two FIFO buffers, independent completion bits
one equality result, error or cancellation

rules.explanation: Both streams are subscribed for one independent comparison; each has a FIFO queue and completion bit.
rules.nextState: Comparing with empty queues and two live source subscriptions.

rules.guard: current side live, opposite FIFO empty and incomplete; buffer below cap
actions: append exact payload to unmatched FIFO
rules.explanation: No output until an opposite value arrives, or comparison becomes decided. Values remain opaque.
rules.nextState: Append one unmatched payload to current side FIFO.

rules.guard: opposite stream already completed and has no unmatched value
actions: emit false, complete and release remaining subscriptions
rules.explanation: A new value after an exhausted, completed opposite stream proves unequal lengths.

rules.guard: opposite FIFO nonempty and strict equality holds against its oldest value
actions: discard one oldest opposite FIFO entry; no output
rules.explanation: Default comparator is strict JavaScript ===, including NaN mismatch and object identity.
rules.nextState: Opposite FIFO shrinks by one while both completion flags remain unchanged.

rules.guard: opposite FIFO nonempty and strict equality fails
actions: emit false then complete; release all live sources
rules.explanation: One unequal aligned pair is sufficient: no need to wait for either source to finish.

rules.guard: current side is live and the other side is not yet completed
actions: release completed source subscription; retain unmatched FIFO
rules.explanation: Completion alone is insufficient while the opposite source might still produce matching values.
rules.nextState: Mark side completed and await the other stream.

rules.guard: opposite stream already completed; unmatched buffers both empty
rules.explanation: Only both completed streams with no unmatched FIFO values are equal.

rules.guard: opposite stream already completed; unmatched buffers not empty
rules.explanation: Only both completed streams with no unmatched FIFO values are equal.
An error is a terminal failure, never converted to a false equality result.
